lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arranged in a grid-like configuration posterior to the gills, consisting of approximately 12-14 vertical columns of high-intensity circular clusters with 4-6 nodes per column visible on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, positioning the blobs as nodal points within a structured rectangular lattice.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge feature extends across the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient with a highlight on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette displays a sparse, stochastic distribution of high-luminance blobs, primarily concentrated on the lower half and anterior margin of the fin's surface.

other_distinctive_markers: The cranial region anterior to the gill slits exhibits a high-density, randomized distribution of significantly smaller high-luminance punctate clusters compared to the organized grid of the mid-body.
